headline: Turkish E-Commerce Volume Projected to Reach 600 Billion Liras During November Promotions
summary: The Electronic Commerce Operators Association forecasts online shopping volume in Turkey to hit 600 billion Turkish liras during November promotional campaigns.
why: Rapid digitisation and consumer shopping shifts have made e-commerce a growing component of retail sales in Turkey.

impacts.name: E-Commerce
impacts.why: High promotional volume increases quarterly revenue growth for domestic e-commerce operators.
